issues.explanation: Manual membershipFor null check duplicates EntityPolicy::view instead of authorizing through the policy/gate as conventions require.
Public input has no #[Validate] or rules() entry and is validated manually with filter_var plus isTransferableAdmin; safe (403 on invalid) but deviates from the #[Validate]+validate() pattern.

conventions.evidence: Policies used everywhere else (Members.php:127,151,169 Settings.php:241,250,262,278 Locked entity in Dashboard.php:72-73 Members.php:112-113 Settings.php:230-231, Fillable attributes, migrations with down(), docs/database-schema.md and CHANGELOG.md updated, Log::channel('audit') in EntityPickController.php:44). Deviations: EntityPickController.php:38 manual membershipFor check instead of policy; Settings.php:238 targetMembershipId has no Validate/rules entry.

readability.evidence: app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:196 resolveMembership, app/Livewire/Entity/Settings.php:348 isTransferableAdmin protected helpers; small focused actions (addMember/assignRole/removeMember/save/delete/transfer); names match contract; no dead code or debug output.

requirements.evidence: database/migrations/2026_10_29_075235_create_entities_table.php: slug unique entities_slug_unique + softDeletes; ..._075236_create_entity_memberships_table.php: FK cascade, role default employee, unique entity_memberships_entity_user_unique, owner_seq storedAs CASE WHEN role='owner' + unique entity_memberships_one_owner; Entity.php:getRouteKeyName slug/memberships/users/owner, EntityMembership casts/scopes, UserRole::manageable, User::membershipFor; EntityPolicy/EntityMembershipPolicy match task; EntityPickController session untouched on 403 + audit log + redirect; Dashboard/Members/Settings mount authorization + Locked entity; transfer demote-then-promote in transaction with lockForUpdate and 403 if owner vanished; routes entity.pick/dashboard/members/membros/settings; lang ui.nav_members/nav_settings/owner notices/transfer_ownership exact strings

scope.evidence: Diff only adds entity slice: models/policies/factories/migrations, EntityPickController, 3 Livewire components + 3 Blade views, 4 routes, lang keys, docs/database-schema.md + CHANGELOG.md, 7 Entity* test files. No onboarding/switcher/middleware/home-dispatch/locale/navbar/cards/invitations/queues/billing/restore.

security.evidence: All mounts authorize (Dashboard.php:77 view, Members.php:120 view, Settings.php:241 manageSettings); every action authorizes (Members.php:127,151,169 Settings.php:250,262,278); resolveMembership checks entity_id match (Members.php:200) + role Rule::in manageable (Members.php:155) + owner demote blocked (Members.php:158); transfer re-checks inside transaction with lockForUpdate (Settings.php:292-306); Locked Entity model; Blade uses {{ }} and @can; fillable allowlists.

simplicity.evidence: Reuses User::membershipFor for all membership checks, UserRole::manageable() for assignRole allowlist, existing x-form-field/x-button components, Eloquent relations; no service/repository layers or speculative abstractions; demote-before-promote comment explains one-owner constraint.

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/EntityTest.php: slug unique/soft-delete/DB second-owner reject/cascade/scopes; EntityMembershipTest.php: unique/factory states; EntityPolicyTest.php: create/view/update/delete/manageSettings/assignRole/delete-self; EntityMembersTest.php: add/duplicate/unknown/employee-403/assign/owner-assign-403/demote-owner-403/remove/self-remove/last-manager/tamper; EntitySettingsTest.php: save/keep-slug/unique/required/delete+session/transfer happy + 4 forbidden + vanished-owner + Locked swap; EntityPagesTest.php: dashboard owner/non-owner/non-member-403/guests/unverified; EntityPickTest.php: pick/403-session-untouched/audit-log-mock/guests/unverified

review.summary: Adds the entity data model with DB-enforced single owner, policies, pick controller, dashboard/members/settings Livewire pages, routes, lang keys, docs and thorough Pest coverage. Meets the task contract with strong security and scope discipline; only nits are manual auth in the pick controller and missing Validate attribute on targetMembershipId.
